          Who is offering to buy my Shares?

              Purchaser, a wholly owned subsidiary of Intel. is offering to purchase for cash all outstanding

          "Mobileye" to refer to Mobileye N.V.

          What are the classes and amounts of securities sought in the Offer?

               We are offering to purchase all outstanding Shares at a purchase price of $63.54 per Share, less any
          applicable withholding taxes and without interest, to the holders thereof, in cash, upon the terms and subject to
